# New features and enhancements

## Self-serve SCIM provisioning setup (28 May)

If you use Enterprise SSO, you can now set up SCIM provisioning yourself in **Subscription** \> **Authentication**. Enterprise SSO is available on the Enterprise plan.

​

You can:

​

- Generate your SCIM credentials.

- Get the SCIM endpoint URL.

- Configure mappings.

- Test the connection.


​

Funnel still sets up your provisioning rules, which map identity provider (IdP) attributes to subscription roles and workspace access. The setup page tells you when to contact your Funnel representative for this step.

​

Read [User provisioning with SCIM](https://help.funnel.io/en/articles/13396822-user-provisioning-with-scim) to learn what you can manage with SCIM.

**Note**: Self-serve SCIM setup isn't enabled by default. Contact Funnel support to enable it for your subscription.

## Funnel AI workspace context (27 May)

Funnel AI can now save knowledge to your workspace so it persists across all Funnel AI sessions.

​

- When you share business rules, KPIs or preferences in chat, Funnel AI can offer to remember them as **workspace instructions**.

- Funnel AI injects saved instructions into every future conversation for all users in the workspace.

- Manage instructions in **Customization** \> **Workspace instructions** in Funnel AI full view.

- Funnel can also add workspace context during onboarding and other setup flows.


​

Read [Customize Funnel AI](https://help.funnel.io/en/articles/12929310-manage-workspace-instructions-in-funnel-ai) for how to save preferences from conversation and manage workspace instructions.

​

Plan availability: All plans

​

## Overdue invoice alerts (26 May)

If your subscription has an overdue invoice, Funnel now shows a banner in the app to alert you. The banner's color and message escalate while the invoice stays unpaid.

​

- All users in the subscription see the banner.

- Subscription owners see a banner with an option to pay the invoice.

- The **Billing** page shows more warnings and information about overdue invoices.


​

When you dismiss the banner, it comes back after 4 to 24 hours, depending on the warning level. Dismissing the banner hides it only in your browser, so other users still see it.

​

Read [Access your invoices](https://help.funnel.io/en/articles/29075-how-do-i-access-my-invoices) to view your payment history and download invoices.

​

## Funnel AI available across the app (22 May)

**Funnel AI** (formerly Data Chat) is now easy to reach from anywhere in Funnel:

​

- Open **Ask Funnel AI** from the top navigation on any page.

- Use the chat widget while you work. It follows you as you navigate and keeps your conversation active when you minimize and restore it.

- Open **Funnel AI** from the sidebar to continue the same conversation in full view; messages sync in real time between the widget and full page.


​

**Funnel AI** covers analytics questions and broader product help (how-to guidance, troubleshooting, field explanations and marketing context), not only data queries.

​

Plan availability: All plans

​

## Image attachments in Funnel AI (22 May)

You can now attach images directly to **Funnel AI** conversations:

​

- Upload PNG or JPEG screenshots (up to five per message, 10 MB each), or paste an image into the chat.

- Ask questions about what you see, useful for troubleshooting errors, interpreting charts and reviewing ad platform screens without describing them in text.


​

Plan availability: All plans

​

## PostgreSQL export destination (20 May)

You can now export Funnel data to a self-managed **PostgreSQL** database. PostgreSQL is available as a beta destination.

​

Plan availability: Available on request (beta). Contact your Funnel representative to enable the destination.

​

## Scheduled exports for data sources (20 May)

You can now schedule recurring exports of your data source inventory for data warehouse and storage export destinations.

​

- Choose which fields to include from the **Data Sources** page during setup.

- Export data sources from the current workspace or from all workspaces in the subscription when the subscription owner enables that option.


​

Plan availability: All plans. Contact your Funnel representative to enable the feature.

​

## Funnel MCP Server (19 May)

You can now bring your Funnel data into the AI products you already use through the Funnel MCP Server. You can connect it as a custom connector in Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, Gemini, Perplexity, Lovable and Copilot.

​

Read the [Quick start guide: Using Funnel MCP](https://help.funnel.io/en/articles/15014203-quick-start-guide-using-funnel-mcp) article for setup instructions.

**Note**: The Funnel MCP Server is awaiting approval and listing in the official Claude and ChatGPT marketplaces.

Plan availability: All plans

​

## Funnel Digital Measurement: Proof of Value with Google Analytics 4 Data-Driven Attribution (12 May)

You can now run a Proof of Value analysis for **Funnel Digital Measurement** using Google Analytics 4 Data-Driven Attribution (GA4 DDA) data. You no longer need event-level GA4 data through BigQuery.

​

- After your marketing mix modeling (MMM) data is mapped and your exports are configured in **Data Hub**, an MMM model can be available in Data Hub in under 48 hours.


**Note**: Preparing the data for MMM still involves configuration work and can take a week or two.

Plan availability: All plans with Funnel Digital Measurement

​

## OpenAI Ads connector (8 May)

You can now connect to OpenAI Ads and bring campaign, ad group and ad-level insights into Funnel.

​

Plan availability: All plans

​

# Updates on dimensions and metrics

## Semrush: New report (26 May)

You can now get campaign information from the Semrush Site Audit API with the new **Site Audit Campaign Report**.

**Note**: This report isn't enabled by default. Contact Funnel support to enable it for your workspace.

Read the [Semrush: Dimensions and metrics](https://help.funnel.io/en/articles/5200293-semrush-dimensions-and-metrics) article to view the complete list of dimensions and metrics you can get from the connector.

​

## Amazon Ads: New dimension (25 May)

You can now get the **Campaign Bidding Strategy** dimension in all **Sponsored Products** reports. It shows the bidding strategy set for the campaign.

​

Read the [Amazon Ads: Dimensions and metrics](https://help.funnel.io/en/articles/5966146-amazon-ads-dimensions-and-metrics) article to view the complete list of dimensions and metrics you can get from the connector.

​

## TikTok: New dimension and updated dimension (25 May)

The **Ad landing page URL** dimension now shows the landing page URL for Smart+ Creative ads in the **Basic** report at ad level. Previously, this dimension was empty for these ads.

​

You can also get the new **Ad landing page URLs** dimension. For ads with more than one landing page URL, it lists all the URLs, separated by commas. For ads with one URL, it shows the same value as **Ad landing page URL**.

​

Read the [TikTok: Dimensions and metrics](https://help.funnel.io/en/articles/3675555-tiktok-dimensions-and-metrics) article to view the complete list of dimensions and metrics you can get from the connector.

​

## Search Ads 360: New report levels (21 May)

You can now choose campaign or ad group level when you get the **Shopping Performance View** report from the Search Ads 360 connector.

​

Read the [Search Ads 360: Dimensions and metrics](https://help.funnel.io/en/articles/8820085-search-ads-360-dimensions-and-metrics) article to view the complete list of dimensions and metrics you can get from the connector.

​

## Spotify Ads Manager: New dimensions (19 May)

You can now get the following dimensions and remote attributes for all Spotify Ads Manager data sources:

​

- **Ad account name**

- **Ad account ID**

- **Business name**

- **Business ID**


​

These dimensions reflect the Spotify account hierarchy: a **Business** contains **Ad accounts**.

​

Read the [What data can I get from Spotify Ad Studio?](https://help.funnel.io/en/articles/4581683-what-data-can-i-get-from-spotify-ad-studio) article to view the complete list of dimensions and metrics you can get from the connector.

​

## TikTok: New report, metrics and deprecated dimension (13 May)

You can now use a new **Custom Events** report that breaks down data by custom event type with proper grain separation. The new report has full dimension parity with the **Basic** report, including campaign, ad group and ad metadata, plus Smart+ resolution.

​

The following metrics are available in the **Custom Events** report:

​

- **Custom events (app)**

- **Custom event value (app)**

- **Cost per custom event (app)**

- **Value per custom event (app)**

- **Custom events (website)**

- **Custom event value (website)**

- **Cost per custom event (website)**

- **Value per custom event (website)**


​

You can now get the following 8 website value metrics in the **Basic** report:

​

- **Add to wishlist value (website)**

- **Registration value (website)**

- **Search value (website)**

- **Payment info value (website)**

- **Form submission value (website)**

- **Button click value (website)**

- **Contact value (website)**

- **Download value (website)**


​

The following 2 app value metrics are now available in the **Basic** report and the **Smart+ Creative** report (previously available only in **Creative Basic**):

​

- **Subscribe value (app)**

- **Checkout value (app)**


**Note**: The **Custom Event Type** optional dimension on the **Basic** report is now deprecated. Use the new **Custom Events** report instead.

Read the [TikTok: Dimensions and metrics](https://help.funnel.io/en/articles/3675555-tiktok-dimensions-and-metrics) article to view the complete list of dimensions and metrics you can get from the connector.

​

## Facebook Ads: New breakdown (12 May)

You can now select **Comscore Market** as a breakdown level when you configure a Facebook Ads data source. Comscore Markets is a set of US ZIP-code-based local market definitions used in linear television and digital media.

​

Read the [What data can I get from Facebook Ads?](https://help.funnel.io/en/articles/1981284-facebook-ads-dimensions-and-metrics) article to view the complete list of dimensions and metrics you can get from the connector.

​

# Beta features

You can use the following [beta features](https://help.funnel.io/en/articles/11081370-what-does-beta-mean) for a limited time at no additional cost. You can share your feedback. Pricing can change when a feature becomes generally available.

​

## Creative charts for Google Ads and TikTok (22 May)

Creative charts in dashboards now support Google Ads and TikTok, in addition to Facebook Ads. Funnel downloads and stores the images from your Google Ads and TikTok ads, so you can show them next to your performance metrics.

​

To turn on creative charts, go to **User Details** \> **Experiments** and turn on **Creative Assets**. The setting applies only to your user.

​

To show creatives in your charts, use these report types:

​

- For TikTok, use the **Creative Basic** report at ad level.

- For Google Ads, use the **Standard** report at asset level.


**Note**: The TikTok **Creative Basic** report isn't enabled by default. Contact Funnel support to enable it for your workspace.

To set up the data sources, read:

​

- [Configure creatives for Google Ads](https://help.funnel.io/en/articles/15877590-configure-creatives-for-google-ads)

- [Configure creatives for TikTok Ads](https://help.funnel.io/en/articles/15877612-configure-creatives-for-tiktok-ads)


​

# Third-party platform changes

## Google Merchant Center: Move to the Merchant API (15 June)

Starting 15 June 2026, the Google Merchant Center connector moves from the legacy Content API to the new Merchant API. As part of this move, 23 fields are deprecated. Some of them have replacement fields.

​

- After 15 June 2026, the deprecated fields stop receiving new data.

- Your data from May 2026 and earlier stays as it is, unless you request a backfill.

- After 15 June 2026, Funnel updates your data from 1 June 2026 onward. This minimizes disruption to your monthly reporting for May and June.


**Note**: If you use the deprecated fields in exports, dashboards or custom metrics, review those configurations before 15 June 2026. Use the replacement fields where they're available.

Read [Google Merchant Center field changes June 2026](https://help.funnel.io/en/articles/15259995-google-merchant-center-field-changes-june-2026) for the full list of deprecated fields and their replacements.

​

## Facebook Pages: Deprecated Marketing API v23 fields (9 June)

Starting 9 June 2026, Meta ends support for 18 Facebook Pages fields from Marketing API v23. Some of them have replacement fields.

​

- After 8 June 2026, these fields stop receiving new data in Funnel.

- Your data from May 2026 and earlier stays as it is, unless you request a backfill.

- After 8 June 2026, Funnel updates your data from 1 June 2026 onward. This minimizes disruption to your monthly reporting for May and June.


**Note**: If you use the deprecated fields in exports, dashboards, custom metrics, BI tools or warehouse models, review those configurations before 8 June 2026. Use the replacement fields where they're available.

Read [Facebook Pages field changes June 2026](https://help.funnel.io/en/articles/15261342-facebook-pages-field-changes-june-2026) for the full list of deprecated fields and their replacements.
